factual_methodology.summary: Core chronology grounded in OSF biography/EBSCO; 1992 ERM mechanism and Britain policy from 1992 Bank of England; trade profit and 2011 family office from attributable Bloomberg reporting; 1997 hedge fund hypothesis NBER; 2000 fund losses contemporary press; ECHR 2011 French conviction and CJEU 2020 Hungary ruling; OSF 2024 and 2025 financial records, OECD 2025, FEC-referencing FactCheck 7 Aug 2026.

editorial_publication_readiness.summary: Long-form biography separates childhood, Popper, arbitrage, fund structure, reflexivity, sterling macro mechanics, crisis and losses, insider-trading judgment, family-office governance, philanthropic inputs, political finance and evidence of measurable outcomes. No unsupported causal claim of global control.

visual_evidence_readiness.summary: EN/PT two numeric bar charts with identical values and dated units; annotated chronology and institution accounting tables; flow diagram and qualitative geography map. Graphs label 2023/2024 rounded spending and 2024 geographical amounts.

research_depth.summary: More than 5,000 words per locale, 17 headings, 22 identical reference URLs, 14+ independent mechanisms and counterfactuals; substantive chronology, investor economics, micro-macro causal discipline and endowment accounting.

evidence_traceability.summary: Each major event has in-text [n] references to 22 bibliographical URLs with cross-locale alignment; primary institutional/court documents used for regimes, law and finance; journalist figures tagged as reported estimates, OECD and academic studies qualify causal limits.

counterfactual_review.summary: Avoids sole-blame sterling trade narrative, rejects empirically unsupported fund-driven Asian crisis causation, includes French insider-trading conviction, technology investment losses, independent assessment finding no robust macro-democratization or destabilization effect, verifies electoral giving while declining unsupported claims of direct election command.

contrary_evidence: NBER 1998 finds no evidence Soros or large currency hedge funds caused 1997 Asian crash.
GSQ 2021 finds no detectable macro effects of OSF grants on measured democratic outcomes and no evidence for claims of protest/migration destabilization.
2000 technology losses contradict the claim of investment infallibility.
Dated UK central-bank record shows the sterling regime was under macroeconomic pressure before a single fund's trades.
limitations: Past returns, fund AUM, personal assets, endowment and annual grants are distinct measures.
OSF geographic spending data are organization-reported; peer-reviewed causal evidence remains limited and mixed.
Attribution of political impacts requires specific filings, grants, recipient actions and comparative outcomes.
Secondary media reports of 1992 profit and 2000 financial losses are distinguished from official accounting.
Quantities in 1992/2000 press reporting are estimated and cannot be independently reconstructed from complete nonpublic Quantum trading ledgers.
The OSF's reported 2024 regional spending and 2023 total are nominal categories; changes do not identify grant outcomes or organizational motive.
Claims about individual actor influence distinguish formal powers and recipient agency from rhetoric about omnipotence.
notes: Editorial QA of exact stage SHA/three source blob SHAs. Judicial, market, philanthropy and political financial instruments separated. Independent automated repository build and remote Cloudflare production verification are separate gates.
